audit.whatIsWrong: Every chart row from Level 2 to First item was given to Volibear, and Level 1 was called Skill — the exact inverse of the page's own why-strings, which say Volibear wins Level 1, Kled wins 2-3, and 4-5, 6 and first item are even.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Volibear/Kled/Kled/Skill/Skill/Skill/Volibear and the matchup sits at 50.77% over 325 games — a genuinely even lane with a Kled window at 2-3 and a Volibear late.
audit.corrected: All seven rows realigned in both layers.

audit.why: Kled spikes at 2-3 and on first item. Volibear spikes at 6 (Stormbringer, 160/135/110s, disables towers) and again on two tank items where Frenzied Maul's heal out-sustains the remount.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Sky Splitter (E) a stun — 'banks Sky Splitter for the stun', 'Bait the Sky Splitter stun', 'Land Sky Splitter (E) stun'. Sky Splitter does not stun.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Sky Splitter: it deals damage and slows, and shields Volibear if he is inside the blast radius. His only stun is Thundering Smash (Q), 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, which is also an auto-attack reset — so the wind-up on the attack is the tell, not the cast. Frenzied Maul (W) is a 5s cooldown that heals only on the second cast into the same target, which is the real reason short trades beat long ones here.
audit.corrected: Stun attributed to Thundering Smash (Q); Sky Splitter described as slow plus shield; W's 5s recast-heal named.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears only as an item name with no timing.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul's second cast is the heal; Grievous Wounds applied before the extended trade is what makes Kled's W procs stick.

edits.before: Land Sky Splitter (E) stun to interrupt your E dash or remount, then bite (W) to heal the trade back
edits.after: Land Thundering Smash (Q) stun to interrupt your dash, then bite W twice to heal the trade back

edits.before: Level 1 is his, not yours — you have no spammable poke and you want Skaarl's mount health preserved, while his W bite slows and heals so he wins the slow grind if you trade into it raw. Sit back, last-hit, and wait for your spike. At 2 your W shotgun shots come online, and at 3 the full re-E (E through him, W on-hit shots, recast E back) plus your free remount health bar wins the all-in clean — do it before his bite-heal scales and before he banks Sky Splitter for the stun. Land Bear Trap first so he can't sidestep the dash back, and don't commit if his E is up to interrupt your re-E.
edits.after: Level 1 is his, not yours — you have no spammable poke and you want Skaarl's mount health preserved, while his W bite heals on the second cast so he wins the slow grind if you trade into it raw. Sit back, last-hit, and wait for your spike. At 2 your W shotgun shots come online, and at 3 the full re-E (E through him, W on-hit shots, recast E back) plus your free remount health bar wins the all-in clean — do it before his bite-heal scales and before Thundering Smash (Q) is up to stun you. Land Bear Trap first so he can't sidestep the dash back, and hold your commit while that 10-12s stun is available.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay roughly even — you still out-trade with W procs and remount sustain on short trades, but his W bite heals back what your Q ticks, so only commit when his Frenzied Maul is on cooldown, not into a fresh bite. At 6 his Stormbringer flips the lane into a coinflip: he charges in, shields, disables your tower, and the chase plus a jungler can punish you the instant you're dismounted or out of remount Courage. Bait the Sky Splitter stun before you re-E — if he lands E on your dash-back you eat the full bite-and-R combo. Keep Bear Trap for peel, not just engage, and don't get caught in your weaker solo form near his dive window.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay roughly even — you still out-trade with W procs and remount sustain on short trades, but his W bite heals on its second cast into you, so commit right after a fresh Frenzied Maul, not before it. At 6 his Stormbringer flips the lane into a coinflip: he leaps in, disables your tower, and the chase plus a jungler can punish you the instant you're dismounted or out of remount Courage. Bait Thundering Smash (Q) before you re-E — that stun is his only lockdown and it is 10-12s. Sky Splitter (E) only slows and shields him, so it is worth eating. Keep Bear Trap for peel, not just engage.

edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash: matchup-defining — His engage. Bait it before committing. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Thundering Smash (Q), 10-12s: his only stun, and an auto reset — the attack wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Bait it, then commit. - Frenzied Maul (W) is 5s and heals on the second cast into you. - Sky Splitter (E), 16s, only slows and shields him.

edits.before: Track Volibear's Thundering Smash (Stun): His engage. Bait it before committing. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Thundering Smash (Q) is his only stun, 10-12s, and it is an auto reset — react to the wind-up. Sky Splitter only slows and shields. Bait Q, then Beartrap and unload W.

edits.before: Beartrap Volibear when his answer is down, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount mid-fight.
edits.after: Apply Grievous Wounds before the extended trade — his second Frenzied Maul cast refunds your W procs otherwise. Then Beartrap and rip the full mounted combo.

notes: Two real errors fixed: the whole level chart was inverted against the packet and the page's own why-strings, and Sky Splitter (E) was described as a stun in three places when Riot's text gives it only a slow and a self-shield — Volibear's stun is Thundering Smash (Q). Whether tenacity meaningfully shortens that stun is not in the kit data and is not asserted.
